raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer surfaced an auto-generated DuckDuckGo snippet claiming “There is a 2010 stage adaptation titled ‘South of the Border,’ likely associated with the 2009 film,” without verification. This unvetted, ambiguous claim (mixing multiple “South of the Border” topics) could mislead the process into believing both films had stage adaptations. Proper disambiguation and corroboration from reliable sources were needed.
